_comment: Example project modeled on the agentic robotics workshop (Nov. 7, 2026). Copy it out of the skill before building: python3 scripts/project.py init ~/work/workshop --example workshop. The registration URL is a placeholder (example.org); set the real one with: project.py set registration_url <url>. The Kent State wordmark starts as the template's working copy: project.py replace-asset ksu-wordmark-white official:ksu-stacked-white-png.
name: agentic-robotics-workshop
title: Agentic workflows for robotics workshop

facts.summary: Learn an agentic workflow through ROS 2 replay and TurtleBot3 simulation.
facts.venue:
Mathematical Sciences Building
Room 228  ·  Kent State University
facts.audience:

Robotics experience optional
agenda: Understand and review a code change
facts.requirements: Prepared Linux environment and an existing agent login required.
workflow: Make and review a small diff
